pages.description: NASA is targeting the first Artemis lunar landing in early 2028. Many of the Pleistocene animals of Tule Springs are still alive today, including the coyote ( Canis latrans ), jackrabbit ( Lepus sp.), and aquatic snails. Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) history and heritage include experiences of people with cultural, religious, and linguistic traditions from India, China, Japan, Korea, the Philippines, Vietnam, Hawai’i, Samoa, Tonga, among other nations from Asia and the Pacific Islands. It is impossible to tell the experiences of these various groups with a single history. The breadth of Asian American and Pacific Islander experience is a vital aspect of America's rich and diverse past. Explore and be part of the rich history and heritage of Asian American and Pacific Islanders found throughout the National Park System and in communities across the country preserved through the work of National Park Service programs and partners. Written 2025-10-30… Published 2026-11-03 About three years ago, during my day-to-day mapping activities, I came across a golf course that had some obvious errors. I didn’t think much of it at the time. Just a fairway that was drawn right across the top of a green. But the more golf courses I looked at, the more frequently I encountered this error. I soon learned about a golf course simulator video game that was built on OpenStreetMap data and was attracting a large influx of simulator enthusiasts who weren’t seasoned OSM mappers. Along with that came various tools to aid in converting OSM data into these simulators, as well as tutorial videos that made some very bad assumptions about how golf courses should be mapped. These factors set the stage for some very bad mapping practices to spread around the world. My understanding is that attempts were made to correct these bad habits at the source, but the tutorial author wasn’t interested in revising or removing his video. Secretary of the Treasury Alexander Hamilton stepped forward with a plan to establish a national bank—which still stands in Independence National Historical Park—that would give the federal government more authority to handle the fiscal situation. His proposal incited a debate that tested the US Constitution’s boundaries and laid the foundation for the country’s financial system. Since then, banking, lending money, and printing currency have continued to grow and fluctuate and entrepreneurial Americans, such as Maggie Walker , have led the banking world to new heights. pages.description: The iconic predator’s estimated abundance means the T. rex fossils we have today are exceedingly rare.
pages.text: Billions of T. rex likely roamed the Earth, paleontologists report | National Geographic Paleontologists figured out how many T. rex lived on Earth—and they found that about 20,000 would have been alive at any given time during a two- to three-million year timespan. Illustration by STOCKTREK IMAGES, Nat Geo Image Collection SCIENCE NEWS Billions of T. rex likely roamed the Earth, paleontologists report The iconic predator’s estimated abundance means the T. rex fossils we have today are exceedingly rare. By Michael Greshko Published April 19, 2021 • 6 min read If you traveled back in time 67 million years ago to ancient Montana, you’d be entering the realm of a tyrant: the iconic predator Tyrannosaurus rex . Before you venture into that lost world, though, you might want to know: On average, how close is the nearest T. rex to you? That might sound like an impossible thing to know—but after crunching through two decades’ worth of T. rex research, a new study provides estimates of the animal’s population density. In all likelihood, a T. rex would be within 15 miles of you, if not much closer. The new study, published last Thursday in Science , also translates these population densities into estimates for how many T. rex ever lived. On average, researchers estimate that some 20,000 T. rex lived at any one time and that about 127,000 generations of the dinosaurs lived and died. Those averages imply that a total of 2.5 billion T. rex lived in the species’ native North America, possibly as far north as Alaska and as far south as Mexico, over a two- to three-million-year timespan.

They are an essential part of American history and embody the strong and resilient characteristics of the American people - so much so that they were designated as our National Mammal in 2016. Once numbering ~30 million and ranging across the United States and in Canada and Mexico, bison were hunted to near extinction, with only several hundred remaining by the 1870’s. Through ongoing conservation work, bison are recovering from a low of fewer than 1,000 individuals. Today, 19 herds in 12 states roam the American Plains. Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn BLM Turns Wildfire Response into Opportunity for Forest Management and Local Industry Aug 21, 2026 Montrose, Colo. – A firebreak along Cimarron Road during the Gold Mountain Fire served another purpose, too: putting removed trees to use. When wildfire conditions make direct suppression difficult or unsafe, firefighters look for places where they can use the landscape to slow a fire's spread. Reducing vegetation along roads can create a break in fuels, giving firefighters another option if conditions change. That approach was used along nearly 2 miles of Cimarron Road northeast of Ridgway. Crews removed vegetation within approximately 75 feet of the roadside to create a potential firebreak if the fire moved in that direction. Before the work began, Ken Smothers, forester with the BLM's Gunnison Field Office, completed an expedited timber cruise to identify trees that could be recovered and sold rather than left as waste. What are the three branches of government? The Constitution of the United States divides the federal government into three branches: Legislative Judicial Executive This ensures that no individual or group will have too much power. Legislative branch The legislative branch is made up of Congress : The U.S. Senate The U.S. House of Representatives It also includes special agencies and offices that provide support services to Congress. The legislative branch’s key roles include: Drafting proposed laws Confirming or rejecting presidential nominations for heads of federal agencies, federal judges, and the Supreme Court Surveying the budget Having the authority to declare war Judicial branch The judicial branch includes the Supreme Court and other federal courts. It evaluates laws by: Interpreting the meaning of laws Applying laws to individual cases Deciding if laws violate the Constitution Executive branch The president, the vice president, and the president's cabinet are the members of the executive branch. The executive branch’s key roles include: The president is the head of state, leader of the executive branch, and commander in chief of the United States armed forces. The vice president supports the president. If the president is unable to serve, the vice president becomes president. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/11/building-intelligence-first-responders-foundation-models-interoperable UPDATES Building Intelligence for First Responders: From Foundation Models to Interoperable Indoor Data November 5, 2026 Share Facebook Linkedin X.com Email Credit: CTL When a disaster strikes outdoors, first responders are able to capture data from a variety of sources to adequately prepare their response. Satellite imagery, GIS, GPS, and drones all provide the ability to gather information about the scene. However, when a disaster happens indoors, none of those capabilities carry over. The available data becomes 2D, typically a blueprint if it exists, and does not include standpipes, shutoffs, alarm panels, or AEDs. These missing elements are necessary for a safe and timely response by first responders. Without indoor spatial intelligence, responders must make high stakes and high-risk decisions with incomplete information. Fixing the issue requires data that cannot be produced at scale and currently relies on manual documentation.
